accepted_figure_alt: A two-panel near-eye figure. The upper panel shows Female and Male fitted melEDI curves across 24 hours with pink and blue lines and pointwise confidence ribbons on a symlog axis that is linear from zero to one lux and logarithmic above one lux; both rise in the morning and decline at night, with the Female curve lower around morning and late afternoon. The lower panel shows the Female-to-Male shifted-value ratio with a horizontal null line at one; the deepest ratio is about 0.47 near 08:45. Intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous.
